info.title: E-Detailing backend API — as consumed by the e-detail-app mobile client
info.description: Client-side contract reverse-engineered from the app (commit e4f6eda). It documents what the app SENDS and READS, not the full server API. Every response body is read after the axios interceptor unwraps response.data. Kept in sync with the code by scripts/specs/validate-specs.mjs (rule API-014). Requirement links are in x-requirements.

appKey.name: x-app-key
appKey.description: Shared OFFLINE_SYNC_KEY for pre-login bootstrap routes

Unauthorized.description: Only code TOKEN_EXPIRED / TOKEN_INVALID / TOKEN_MISSING ends the session (AUTH-FR-007)

Error.description: Error; message shown to the user where relevant

code.description: TOKEN_EXPIRED | TOKEN_INVALID | TOKEN_MISSING on auth failures

username.description: Email identifier: "<employee no><EXPO_PUBLIC_LOGIN_EMAIL_DOMAIN>" unless the input contained "@"

token.description: JWT; expiry from its exp claim

teamId.description: Required by the app — login rejected when null

mieId.description: Required by the app — login rejected when null

DoctorClass.description: A1 / A2 / A3 / A4 … for this rep

MaxVisitCount.description: Monthly quota of the class; null when unclassified

client_call_id.description: Client UUID; server upserts on it

doctorid.description: Numeric string; absent on a group "started" row

arrived_within_vicinity.description: Within 50 m of day or evening clinic

slide_time_detail.description: jsonb — [{ order, forcing, brand, sku, url, seconds }]

clientId.description: Outbox row id, echoed in results

status.description: HTTP-style per-item status. 4xx = this row is wrong (counts toward 5-strike removal); 5xx or absent = server fault (kept).

forcing.description: Play order: priority × 100 + sequence; null sorts last

duration.description: Minimum seconds; first number parsed, default 10

clientId.description: client_patient_id, or "s_no:<n>" for a legacy edit

practiceSites.description: Every practice location in order; practiceLocations is its length, and primary*/secondary* mirror locations 1 and 2 (DINFO-DATA-003)
Every practice location in order; absent from a server without this change (DINFO-DATA-003, DINFO-FR-012)

DoctorProfileRow.description: Plus every DoctorProfileInput field (string | number | null)
